name: Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of materials and equipment in the organic light-emitting diode (OLED) industry in China and internationally. The company offers transmission functional materials; electronic functional materials; luminescent functional materials; OLED intermediate, and other functional materials. Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Changchun, China.
